name: Earthen Echo
summary: The Earthen Ring asks you to bring a strange Titan Relic to Muln Earthfury in northwest Mulgore. Its carvings may hold wisdom about buried ruins and forgotten lands.

sections.title: A Relic for the Elders
sections.body: An unnamed observer sees the Titan Relic as more than a carving and urges you to take it to Muln Earthfury. You can find him with the Earthen Ring council at Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore. The elders may study it, for its meaning could touch buried ruins and forgotten lands.

sections.title: The Shard's Memory
sections.body: At Skywatcher Plateau, Muln Earthfury finds that the shard carries a voice like the world's own. Light within it holds memories and flashes of history. The Earthen Ring will guard and study the titan machine, then share what it reveals when they can understand its messages.

faq.q: Who should I bring the Titan Relic to?
faq.answer: Bring the Titan Relic to Muln Earthfury, who is with the Earthen Ring council at Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.
It appears to be more than a carving, and the Earthen Ring may find wisdom in it about buried ruins and forgotten lands.
Muln Earthfury and the other Earthen Ring elders are at Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.

faq.q: What will the Earthen Ring do with the relic?
faq.answer: The Earthen Ring will safeguard and study the relic, and share its messages when they are able to understand them.
